title: Cluster Stats (long-horizon)
description: Twice-daily cluster telemetry persisted by the private-ops cluster-stats CronJob (12h windows). Source: cluster_stats DB on q-postgres.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, 'ready' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'nodes.ready' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'total' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'nodes.total' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'pods' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'pods.total' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'firing' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'firing' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'free' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'disk.media.free_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'errors' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'errors' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, '5xx' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'traefik.requests.by_class' AND labels = '{"status_class": "5xx"}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'node' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'node.cpu.avg_pct'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'node' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'node.memory.used_pct'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'node' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'node.disk.root.used_pct'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'node' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'node.pods'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'restarts' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'pods.restarts' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'oomkilled' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'pods.oomkilled' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'namespaces' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'objects.namespaces' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'deployments' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'workloads.deployments' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'pvcs' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'objects.pvcs' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'services' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'objects.services' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'node' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'node.cpu.commit_pct'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'mem ' || (labels->>'node') AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'node.memory.commit_pct' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'apiserver p99 (s)' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'apiserver.latency_p99_seconds' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'req/s' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'apiserver.requests_per_second' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'etcd' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'etcd.db_size_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'mount' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'disk.used_pct' AND labels->>'host' = 'hoyt' AND labels->>'mount' LIKE '/mnt/media%' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'free' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'disk.media.free_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'mount' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'disk.used_delta_bytes' AND labels->>'host' = 'hoyt' AND labels->>'mount' LIKE '/mnt/media%' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'provisioned' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'longhorn.volumes.provisioned_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'actual' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'longhorn.volumes.actual_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'snapshots' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'longhorn.volumes.snapshot_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'backups (B2)' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'longhorn.backups.bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'node' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'longhorn.node.used_pct'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'robustness' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'longhorn.volumes.by_robustness'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'backups in error' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'longhorn.backups.by_state' AND labels = '{"state": "error"}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'cluster' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'cnpg.size_bytes'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'txns ' || (labels->>'cluster') AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'cnpg.transactions' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'wal archived ' || (labels->>'cluster') AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'cnpg.wal.archived' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'storage' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'harbor.storage_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'messages' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'messages' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'errors' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'errors' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'warnings' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'warnings' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'namespace' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'messages.by_namespace'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'namespace' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'errors.by_namespace'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'status_class' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'traefik.requests.by_class'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'host' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'traefik.host.requests'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'unique clients' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'traefik.unique_clients' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'authentik logins' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'authentik.logins' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'authentik failures' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'authentik.login_failures' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, '429s' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'traefik.requests.429' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'bytes' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'traefik.bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'host' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'traefik.host.bytes' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'index bytes' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'indices.size_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'journal bytes' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'journal.size_bytes' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'firing' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'firing' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'suppressed' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'suppressed' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, 'distinct fired in window' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'fired.distinct' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, labels->>'alertname' AS metric, value FROM stat WHERE metric = 'fired.instance_seconds'  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT r.id, r.started_at, r.ok, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS seconds, (SELECT count(*) FROM stat s WHERE s.run_id = r.id) AS stats, r.notes->'collectors' AS collectors FROM run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 50
